implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are mandatory when a person acquires or holds shares exceeding 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70% or 90% of equity; this filing signals a material change in shareholding structure requiring public disclosure and potential open offer obligations.

headline: Indian Oil Corporation files SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Indian Oil Corporation Limited has submitted a disclosure to NSE under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, indicating either a substantial acquisition of shares in or by the company or a change in control threshold.
detail: SEBI Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares and takeover events. The submission to NSE indicates either IOC has acquired or been subject to a substantial acquisition triggering the threshold reporting requirements. The specific acquirer, shareholding percentage, consideration and nature of the acquisition are contained in the detailed disclosure document filed with the exchange.
